en.heroIntro: Rongqi Lu holds a master's degree in Control Engineering from Xidian University. Lu's research focuses on multi-robot coordination and multi-agent reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on communication-efficient collaboration, reliable decision-making and autonomous exploration in complex environments.
en.beyondResearch: Beyond research, Lu explores AI-assisted development and self-hosted systems, with interests in edge computing and index investing. This work applies engineering methods to understand complex systems, develop practical tools and refine them through hands-on experimentation.

zh.heroIntro: 陆荣琦，获西安电子科技大学控制工程硕士学位。研究方向为多机器人协同与多智能体强化学习，重点关注复杂环境下的高效通信、协同决策与自主探索，致力于提升多智能体系统的协作效率与可靠性。
zh.beyondResearch: 研究之外，持续探索 AI 辅助开发与自托管系统，关注边缘计算与指数化投资。注重以工程方法理解复杂系统，将想法转化为实用工具，并在实践中检验和改进。
